spec.note: Markup/classes are the UI spec (M1 v2, LOCKED). The C9 DOM diff pins to the SIGNED post-amendment hash of these three sections (see MOCKUP-AMENDMENT-GATE.md).

read_set_law: The open paint reads ledger/run-record/reflection/roadmap projections ALONE (roadmap IS in the open read set). Zero model calls until John speaks. Stores marked availability=planned are the W4 chamber sidecar manifest / event-time projections and their W5 derivations - each such cell MUST carry non-empty 'grounding' (what existing data or commission-time declaration feeds it) and 'brownfield' (how W5 derives it for pre-manifest campaigns, or the honest degraded/absent route). A silent drop is a lint failure.
